# Shell's `$(...)`, `do ... done` and awk's braces inside a site's
# braces. Tcl reads a braced argument literally, and so does the parser:
# the body is data, never read as Tcl, so nothing in it can fail the file
# (the old tree-sitter grammar parsed every brace as a script and had to
# excuse its own errors there).
exec sh -c | shell | { | sh | - | "ls $(pwd) | wc -l"
exec bash -c | shell | { | bash | - | "for f in *; do echo \"$f\"; done"
exec sh -c | shell | { | sh | - | "awk '{print $1}' notes"
